The '''Mbandamonte sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Aguarl 3]], [[Cuirilla]] and [[Ruten]].
